fields.name: EPS attach type IEI
fields.description: Information Element Identifier for EPS attach type

fields.name: Spare
fields.description: Bit 4 of octet 1 is spare and shall be coded as zero

fields.name: EPS attach type value
fields.description: Values: 001=EPS attach, 010=combined EPS/IMSI attach, 011=EPS RLOS attach (NOTE), 110=EPS emergency attach, 111=reserved. All other values are unused and shall be interpreted as 'EPS attach' if received by the network.

notes: All other values are unused and shall be interpreted as 'EPS attach', if received by the network.
Bit 4 of octet 1 is spare and shall be coded as zero.
EPS RLOS attach shall be interpreted as 'EPS attach' by a network not supporting attach for access to RLOS.
